note: Deviations from PREREG-TRACKER (§8) that change a frozen file. freeze.mjs --check accepts a drifted file only when its sha256 equals the one recorded here, so a later unrecorded edit still stops the paid steps.

D1.why: E8 environment faults (call timeouts, stopped worlds) excluded from judge and score, never scored; see PREREG-TRACKER.md §8 D1.

D2.why: Check semantics v2 (app/core/tracker/semantics.mjs) beside the frozen v1; judge steps write both. v1 statuses identical on s0 (same-statuses.mjs); all journaled capture and bind requests rebuild byte for byte (verify-prompts.mjs). See PREREG-TRACKER.md §8 D2.

D3.why: Check semantics v3 (app/core/tracker/semantics.mjs, checks.mjs, index.mjs; E8 reversal pairs in experiments/tracker-v2/e8.mjs) beside the frozen v1 and v2; judge steps write judge-v3 files and a single-build view (t2Solo); run-e8 skips builds whose every world faulted in prepare and takes a second bind sample. v1 and v2 statuses unchanged; journaled capture and bind requests rebuild byte for byte (verify-prompts.mjs: 157 identical, 0 different). See PREREG-TRACKER.md §8 D3.

D4.why: Review fixes after the held-out scoring (RESULT-TRACKER.md §11, PREREG-TRACKER-H2.md): semantics v4 = v3 + R-copy-names (scenarios.mjs fresh names that neither contain nor are contained in the original's) + R-per-run (checks.mjs: a sourceless count is counted per run on the repeat view; practice.mjs joinViews tags each effect with its run); v4 becomes the product default (semantics.mjs, index.mjs docs); model.mjs toConditions replaces a capture summary that names a routing literal (address, URL, @handle, #channel) the words never gave by the quote (review m3). v1, v2 and v3 statuses are unchanged (judge-key-v3-s0 re-derivation, same-statuses.mjs); every prompt is byte-identical.
